comment: Genera where species-level identification from a photograph is unreliable enough that a card must ask for genus only. Per docs/decisions.md 2026-08-07, this is a safety net catching a handful of cards, not a primary filter: frequency ranking already excludes most hard taxa because rarely-observed taxa are the hard-to-identify ones. If this list starts catching distinctive species, narrow it rather than widening it.
source: Apomictic complexes and graminoid genera in the northeastern North American flora.
